purpose: Keep RedCap's project-structure refactor and public CLI release remediation ordered, evidence-driven, and honest about what is still blocked.

truth_corrections.claim: P4-2f information architecture and runtime artifact governance is completed, not in-progress.

nodes.title: npm package whitelist preflight and structure refactor task-tree reanchor
nodes.reason: Map the package surface before moving, deleting, or promoting historical assets; fix stale parent-ledger truth first.

nodes.title: Runtime/project/user boundary physical split and CLI workspace context separation
nodes.reason: A public CLI must operate on a managed project workspace while the npm package remains runtime implementation.

nodes.title: CLI doctor/debug/trace/error/help product-surface hardening
nodes.reason: External users need understandable diagnostics and support surfaces after the runtime/workspace boundary is clear.

nodes.title: Public package identity, license, and curated package surface preparation
nodes.reason: Public package metadata, license posture, source visibility, and pack surface must be finalized before release readiness.

nodes.title: Public redcap-arsenal content strategy and claim boundary
nodes.reason: This tranche turns public arsenal claim wording and populated-content thresholds into a machine-checked boundary without blocking CLI release engineering; it now supports both template-only and first reviewed-substantive states.

nodes.title: Historical asset public distillation and RedCap Forge export triage
nodes.reason: Private historical assets now have a first minimal RedCap Forge-reviewed public promotion sample set in redcap-arsenal; broader/bulk public migration remains out of scope.

nodes.title: Historical asset public distillation preflight
nodes.reason: Before any public export, deletion, or migration, RedCap must first prove the RedCap Forge dry-run gate can classify historical assets without writing raw private content to redcap-arsenal.

nodes.title: Agent reading absorption and long-term memory alignment
nodes.reason: Absorb AI Era agent-design guidance into RedCap's long-term-memory and engineering discipline only through machine-checked boundaries, without enabling full LLM Wiki, direct public writeback, or RAG/GraphRAG by default.

nodes.title: LLM-wiki asset stratification and requirement registration
nodes.reason: Classify RedCap's control, evidence, knowledge, public, index, and executable assets before implementing any LLM-wiki-lite semantic memory layer.

nodes.title: LLM-wiki-lite semantic memory lifecycle implementation
nodes.reason: Implemented the minimum private, source-anchored, non-authoritative LLM-wiki-lite lifecycle with Forge-gated public promotion and no RAG/GraphRAG by default.

nodes.title: Runtime minimum compatible physical layout
nodes.reason: P4-2i creates a package-visible runtime root with compatibility wrappers, removing the previous no-runtime-root / dry-run-only release blocker without moving tool trees or enabling public publish.

nodes.title: Pre-release non-release productization closure
nodes.reason: P4-2k narrows the package surface to the curated runtime-readiness profile, adds the runtime import map and public release handoff, and closes non-release productization gaps without enabling npm publish.

nodes.title: Full LLM-wiki product, background distillation and advanced retrieval
nodes.reason: Full LLM-wiki, background generator, vector store, RAG/GraphRAG and public writeback remain future work behind retrieval-scale thresholds and a separate design/release boundary; LLM-wiki-lite must not be presented as this product.

nodes.title: Formal runtime / CLI package public release
nodes.reason: The actual npm/public release task remains blocked until all P0 release blockers are closed and the human release boundary is explicitly satisfied.

must_not_claim: Do not claim RedCap is public-release-ready before P4-2b, P4-2c, and P4-2d are completed and validated.
Do not claim historical assets have been publicly migrated into redcap-arsenal.
Do not claim npm pack dry-run success equals a safe or excellent public CLI product.
Do not bulk-delete or bulk-move historical evidence just to make package checks pass.
Do not claim redcap-arsenal is mature or complete because it contains a first reviewed-substantive public entry set.
Do not claim P4-2h-1 implements a complete LLM Wiki, RAG/GraphRAG, ai-professor production mode, or direct public writeback.
Do not claim P4-2h-2 implements LLM-wiki-lite; it only completes asset stratification and registers P4-2h-3.
Do not claim P4-2h-3 is a complete LLM-wiki product, public knowledge base, RAG/GraphRAG system, automatic background generator, or release blocker.
Do not claim P4-2i's minimum runtime layout equals a full execution-layer split or public-release-ready package.
Do not claim P4-2k enables npm publish, chooses a license, or satisfies registry credential decisions.
acceptance_gates: Parent ledger must mark P4-2b and P4-2c completed before P4-2d package identity/surface remediation starts.
Package surface preflight must be whitelist-driven and must explain historical assets as excluded evidence, not as deleted residue.
Release readiness must continue to fail closed while manual release blockers remain open.
Prism review must be bound before this task-tree reanchor can be closed.
